title: Short-Term Energy Outlook, October 2026
summary_points: EIA's October outlook forecasts Brent at $105 per barrel in the fourth quarter of 2026, an upward revision of $14 per barrel from its September outlook.
EIA forecasts Brent averaging $84 per barrel in 2027; this is a forecast, not an observed future price.
EIA forecasts Henry Hub natural gas averaging $3.16 per million British thermal units in 2027, down 9% from 2026.
EIA forecasts U.S. wholesale electricity prices averaging $52 per megawatt hour in 2026, 11% above 2025.
Within that electricity forecast, EIA projects a 41% increase in PJM wholesale prices and a 23% decline in Northwest Mid-Columbia prices in 2026.
EIA finalized the model inputs on October 1, 2026. The outlook does not specifically account for subsequent market events.
